cases.name: applicable_context
cases.transformation: Use the base fixture after explicit fixture admission.
cases.expected_behavior: deviation alert + cited draft; no confirmed root cause

cases.name: wrong_model_decoy
cases.transformation: Rank the DEMO-P900 chunk highest before graph filtering.
cases.expected_behavior: wrong-model chunk excluded from generation input and citations

cases.name: missing_context
cases.expected_behavior: alert remains; abstain from contextual cause; show missing evidence

cases.name: conflicting_context
cases.transformation: Add a same-scope current approved chunk contradicting the first hypothesis.
cases.expected_behavior: expose conflict, keep cause inconclusive and preserve alert

cases.name: unattributed_work_order_fault
cases.transformation: Provide two component spans plus FailedState without an attachment relation.
cases.expected_behavior: show unattributed fault warning; never present no fault recorded as absence of failure

cases.name: bad_numeric_binding
cases.transformation: Change model F-TEMP-MEAN value from 80 to 85, or unit from degC to A.
cases.expected_behavior: reject draft; keep numeric facts and alert unchanged

cases.name: unknown_citation
cases.transformation: Add a nonexistent chunk or graph path ID to model output.
cases.expected_behavior: reject draft and expose unresolved citation

cases.name: model_unavailable
cases.transformation: Cause the configured live explanation endpoint to fail.
cases.expected_behavior: degraded explanation status; alert/evidence/expert review still available

cases.name: stale_evidence
cases.transformation: Generate against an old pack, then change document/graph revision before review.
cases.expected_behavior: mark draft stale and revalidate/regenerate; preserve the old revision

cases.name: insufficient_observations
cases.transformation: Remove expected samples below the configured coverage gate or make them stale.
cases.expected_behavior: data-quality notice, no healthy declaration or invented diagnosis

cases.name: unreviewed_work_orders
cases.transformation: Omit explicit mapping/annotation decisions in source-data mode.
cases.expected_behavior: stop at review; no approved-record report or fabricated reviewer

cases.name: failed_rerun
cases.transformation: Complete one report, then make the next run fail during extraction or rendering.
cases.expected_behavior: failed new run is explicit; no old output advertised as its report

coverage_note: These are 12 transformations, not 12 independently sampled incidents; the later 30-family evaluation set remains to be built and reviewed.
